audit.why: Both layers give Skill 0-3, Locke 4-5, Skill 6, the whys explain each row in those terms, and the packet chart agrees. Win rate 51.05% over 1710 games supports a genuinely even lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] has only 3 entries; the fourth is structurally absent (packet defect).
audit.why: The kit supplies a real fourth stage the page never covers: Soul Ignition (W) is 18/17/16/15/14s and heals back a portion of the self-damage taken during it, so a timed Grievous Wounds purchase is its own spike.
audit.corrected: spikes[3].text and spikes[3].when created with the anti-heal window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four interactions absent: Silver Stake (P) is on-hit magic damage scaling with the target's MISSING health; Soul Ignition (W) deals true damage and self-heals; Ashen Pursuit (E) is an auto-attack reset; Purgatory (R) grounds as well as executes.
audit.why: Kit flags: P onHit + missing-health scaling, W trueDamage + heal, E dash + autoReset, R grounding + execute + zone. The page treats R purely as an execute and never mentions the grounding, which matters because it removes the escape it is telling you to make.
audit.corrected: Grounding added to the Do's, the missing-health passive to the Don'ts, and the true-damage / auto-reset / anti-heal package to the interactions row.

audit.why: The cooldown block already names E (10s flat) as the lane's decisive window and R as the no-fight condition. Nothing to correct.

edits.after: Soul Ignition is 18s at rank 1 and refunds a portion of the self-damage he took during it — buy Grievous Wounds for that window and his sustain button becomes a straight health cost he cannot undo.

edits.before: Locke wastes Ritual Nails — that is your full-commit window.
edits.after: Purgatory grounds — Flash is your only exit once the zone lands.

edits.before: That is Locke’s favourite window — refusing it removes half his win condition.
edits.after: His passive grows with your missing health — chip you took counts twice.

edits.before: Track Locke’s Ritual Nails (Marks): The nail marks are his whole engine — without 2-3 stacks on you his blink-in barely dents; sidestep the recasts and punish the ten seconds of nothing. Commit only while it is down.
edits.after: Soul Ignition deals true damage and self-heals on an 18s timer, and Ashen Pursuit resets his auto — the burst tell is the attack wind-up after the blink, not the cast. Bring Grievous Wounds before any long trade.
